text:
marta: Heads-up — noticed a parity/regression between the Node SDK and the REST API around model rollback and default token handling. Sampleapp replies get silently truncated when calling via SDK but not when hitting the curl REST path.
ryan: ugh. can you paste a repro? I haven't seen that one.
marta: minimal repro in prod canary: sampleapp calls client.models.rollback(modelId) — SDK call returns a truncated string (ends with "..."), but curl to /v1/models/:id/rollback returns full text. No errors in logs.
kevin: i tried locally. SDK defaults max_tokens to 256 in our client constructor, while REST leaves it unspecified (server-side generator uses model's max). So SDK was clamping output without warning.
sam: also noticed that SDK auto-retries 429s by default (3 attempts with exp backoff). When rollback is a non-idempotent operation that triggers side effects, the retry caused double-rollbacks in our canary.
deploy-bot: deploy #canary-2026-03-22 failed: observed duplicate rollback events; rollback executed twice (trace: abc123 -> abc123-dup). See logs: https://internal/logs/abc123
marta: snippet of what I ran (node):
```
// node sdk
const r = await client.models.rollback('model-prod-v2');
console.log(r.output.slice(0, 200));
```
and curl path:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/model-prod-v2/rollback -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"
```
ryan: can you paste the SDK response vs curl response differences?
kevin: here's an anonymized diff from my run:
```
SDK: "The request completed but the response was truncated due to token limit..."
REST: "The request completed. Finalized weights at commit f1e2d3... full log and metadata attached"
```
marta: exact. SDK collapsed the output because max_tokens defaulted to 256. There's no warning or error code.
kevin: minimal fix options:
- set SDK default max_tokens = null/undefined so server decides (matches REST)
- add explicit validation and a warning when SDK client constructs a request with max_tokens set
- change rollback API to be idempotent (hard)
- stop SDK from retrying non-idempotent endpoints by adding per-endpoint retry metadata
sam: i think we should treat rollback as non-idempotent and opt out of retrying. We already have endpoint metadata for mutating vs read in the router, but the SDK's retry layer currently ignores that for some calls originating from sampleapps.
ryan: agreed. immediate actions:
1) kevin to open PR to change default max_tokens to undefined and add unit tests (SDK)
2) sam to add per-endpoint retry metadata and disable auto-retries for rollback endpoints
3) update sampleapp quickstart to call client.models.rollback({force: true}) explicitly and document that rollback is non-idempotent
4) check Python and go SDKs for same behavior
kevin: opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/458 — changes default, adds test against test-api, and adds a deprecation warning in logs if user sets a lower-than-model max_tokens.
sam: filed DX bug: DX-412 — repro steps, curl vs sdk example, log snippet, and suggested patch. tagging eng-runtime and eng-platform.
ryan: i'll run a quick canary after kevin's PR lands. please add a feature flag so we can roll back if it causes downstream errors.
marta: also update docs with an explicit note: "SDK previously defaulted max_tokens=256; this caused silent truncation. We now leave max_tokens undefined to match REST behavior. If you rely on a fixed token budget set it explicitly."
kevin: PR updated with flag and changelog.
sam: python SDK also had same default. i'll coordinate a simultaneous patch so behavior matches across languages.
marta: thanks all. please ping here when PRs are merged. :thumbsup:
ryan: ack, will follow up with canary results.
kevin: merged -> willary rollout in 30m.
marta: nice. closing loop once canary passes.
